title: 36 Hours in Verona, Italy
abstract: Culturally vibrant Verona, just a short trip from both Milan and Venice, remains one of Italy’s most underrated cities.

title: 36 Hours in Oslo
abstract: A visit to Norway’s capital could drain your wallet, but given everything you’ll find there, you might consider it a bargain.

title: 36 Hours in Vancouver, British Columbia
abstract: In this stunning city, even commutes can be attractive. But Vancouver’s appeal doesn’t end with the outdoors.

title: 36 Hours in Gettysburg, Pa.
abstract: As crowds descend on this small town to mark the battle’s 150th anniversary, here’s a look at what they’ll find, from history to dining to wine.
